fields.Name: T076 - Admin Users Section
fields.Description: Opens the Admin app's Users sub-section once, then walks its bespoke user-management controls (bulk-selection toolbar, filter popover narrowing, card expand with details and roles), verifying each via checkpoints. Consolidates old T186, T187, T188.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Admin application via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, open 'Identity & Access', and select the 'Users' sub-section. Then walk these controls IN ORDER, and as you arrive at each one set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) users-bulk-selection — click the selection checkbox on one or two user rows (or the 'Select All' checkbox in the header) and confirm a contextual bulk-action toolbar appears showing the selected count and buttons for Enable, Disable, Assign Role, and Delete plus a Clear control; then click 'Clear' and confirm the bulk toolbar disappears (do NOT execute any bulk action); (2) users-filter-popover — click the 'Filters' button in the header card to open the filter panel, apply a Status (Active/Inactive) or Role filter, and confirm the users list narrows to matching rows (or shows a valid no-results state) with the X-of-Y count badge and applied-filter indicator updating; then clear the filters and confirm the full list returns; (3) users-card-expand — click a user card header (not its checkbox) to expand it and confirm the expanded panel reveals a stats section (Type, Full Name, Created, Updated) and an 'Assigned Roles' section listing the user's roles (or a 'No roles assigned' message); click the header again to collapse it. Keep going until every control has been exercised. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait for content rather than navigating away.

checkpoints.name: users-bulk-selection
checkpoints.instruction: select users and use the bulk toolbar
visualCriteria: Selecting one or more users via the row checkboxes (or Select All) reveals a bulk-action toolbar with a selection count and Enable / Disable / Assign Role / Delete buttons, and clicking Clear removes the bulk-action toolbar

checkpoints.name: users-filter-popover
checkpoints.instruction: filter the users list via the popover
visualCriteria: Opening the 'Filters' popover and applying a status or role filter narrows the Users list to matches (or shows a valid no-results empty state) and updates the X-of-Y count badge, and clearing the filters restores the unfiltered list

checkpoints.name: users-card-expand
checkpoints.instruction: expand a user card to show details and roles
visualCriteria: Clicking a user card header expands it to reveal a stats section (Type / Full Name / Created / Updated) and an 'Assigned Roles' section (roles list or 'No roles assigned'), and clicking the header again collapses the card
